rules.rule: Each role loads only required + optional skills per profile. Forbidden skills must not be loaded.
Role skill loads must route through Manual Router for proof-of-read
Frontend roles do not load backend/db/security manuals unless route explicitly requires
Backend roles do not load UI manuals unless route explicitly requires
Security/QA/Verifier/Auditor are readonly — no implementation skills loaded
Skill misuse is a drift risk — Auditor checks skill loads against role profile
